Four steps, every single time.

01

You describe the car you need

Budget, body type, must-haves — mileage, seating, boot space. Plain language, no filters to configure.

02

It checks live listings, not memory

Prices and availability change daily. Arclight searches current listings and spec sheets instead of guessing from training data.

03

Comparisons stream in as they happen

Every listing pulled and every spec compared shows up in the trace live, so you see the reasoning, not just a verdict.

04

You get one grounded recommendation

A specific car, priced today, with the trade-offs stated plainly — not a list of ten options to research yourself.

agent-trace.log

Built for the messy real world.

Live listings search

Pulls current inventory and prices when a recommendation depends on what's actually available today.

True cost calculator

On-road price, EMI, and running cost run through real arithmetic — not a language model's approximation of one.

Streamed, not batched

Every listing checked and spec compared arrives the moment it's ready — no spinner hiding what's actually happening.

Rate-limited & sandboxed

Server-side API keys, capped tool loops, and per-user throttling. Built to survive real showroom traffic, not just a demo.

Your next car, found honestly.

Arclight runs on your own Gemini API key, so there's no seat cost from us — you pay Google's usage pricing directly, and you can see exactly what each search costs.
